metric_semantics.Acc7: All rows: clip predictions and labels to [-3,3], NumPy round (half to even), exact class match.
metric_semantics.Acc2: Exclude labels exactly equal to 0; classify prediction >=0 and label >=0.
metric_semantics.F1: Same nonzero rows and binary thresholds; class-support-weighted F1, not macro or positive-class-only F1.
metric_semantics.MAE: All rows, original unclipped regression predictions.
metric_semantics.Corr: All rows, Pearson correlation; undefined for a constant vector or fewer than 2 rows.
metric_semantics.Has0_Acc2_and_F1: Additional all-row binary metrics; neutral label belongs to the nonnegative class.
metric_semantics.units: Acc7, Acc2 and F1 stored as fractions; display as percentages. Corr fraction, MAE original sentiment scale.
metric_semantics.precision: Independent CPU float64 aggregation; no rounding, clipping or calibration of regression predictions.

roles: Existing official DEV229 only, selected and previously explored. Descriptive reaggregation, no new model inference, fit, seed choice, checkpoint/threshold/readout selection, TEST arrays, new generalization or stability claim.
comparisons: Three prespecified own final default-control predictions and one predeclared cached CaReFlow seed128 DEV; no matched seed/training-capacity claim.
future_new_flow: After original100 preservation and earliest INNER-selected full-state replay: same five metrics on fixed predictions; no separate best checkpoint per metric, no Test-guided optimization.
all_five_rule: Acc7,Acc2,F1,Corr strictly higher and MAE strictly lower on the same eligible evaluation rows/protocol, using unrounded values; partial wins recorded separately. Paper row cannot decide DEV superiority.
